program: APPUI-01 — Windows 11 ARM64 Working App Visual Prototype
purpose: Materialize the first representative real Windows desktop assembly around the frozen Stage so hierarchy, navigation, Stage adjacency, Character presence, inspector behavior and causal-history placement can be judged as compositions rather than abstract gates.

engineering_truth_observed.boundary: E0-D blocked before execution; live execution/provider traffic not authorized. The compositions therefore make no E0-D, provider-runtime, WinUI-runtime, package, WACK or Store-readiness claim.

frozen_stage_source.file_name: Kymaean Core Stage Background Successor 01 — Frozen.png
frozen_stage_source.use: Exact pixel crops only inside the new shell compositions; no Stage geometry, scenery or Character-cone redesign.

files.file_name: APPUI-01 Composition A — Live Stage Workspace.png

working_direction.shell: Quiet low-chroma Windows desktop frame with compact durable-scope rail and persistent Production/Scene anchors; identity concentrated at title/scope rather than repeated as component ornament.
working_direction.stage: Frozen Stage remains the visual/semantic center and strongest chromatic field.
working_direction.character: Selected Character uses explicit name plus sparse CPS-B-inspired distributed recognition cues and semantic state/relationship text; no portrait dependency.
working_direction.history: Causal history is adjacent to present work: accepted event, changed condition and unresolved movement remain distinguishable without promoting History to a disconnected application mode.
working_direction.state: Persistent selection and keyboard-focus witness are intentionally separate non-color carriers in the working composition.
working_direction.color: Cool low-chroma supporting shell is provisional synthesis exploration only; CLR F2/F1 remains unselected and no final palette is claimed.
working_direction.typography_material_motion: Working composition choices only; no final typeface/material/motion authority is created.

pass_1_findings: Live Stage crop clipped inherited left-edge text.
Navigation rail labels were visually awkward.
Production overview Stage preview was initially too reduced/letterboxed.
repairs: Changed live Stage crop to contained exact-pixel source framing.
Reduced history density and increased action separation.
Shortened rail labels while preserving durable-scope meaning.
Changed overview preview to a larger exact Stage Character-field crop.
remaining_questions: Director reaction to the overall shell-to-Stage depth relationship and density.
Whether the causal-history adjacency is the right prominence for the working experience.
Whether the provisional cool supporting shell feels meaningfully Kymaean or too conventional before further iteration.

explicit_non_authority: No final APPUI selection or production design system.
No CLR winner, final typography, material, motion, Character artwork or final navigation labels.
No change to PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 pixels/geometry authority.
No WinUI/XAML implementation or Windows runtime accessibility validation.
No ARM64 performance, MSIX/package identity, WACK, Partner Center, Store certification or shipping authority.
No Director taste decision is inferred from creation of this pass.
next: Present both compositions to the Director for reaction, then iterate the representative Windows desktop assembly. Do not reconcile or merge concurrent Website Sol history merely to continue APPUI.
